question: Who is the playback singer and composer of the famous song "Qismat Ki Hawa" which featured in the movie Ludo in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**C. Ramchandra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramchandra **was both the** playback singer and composer** of the famous song **"Qismat Ki Hawa" **in the movie** Ludo (2020).**
 
• C. Ramchandra was an **Indian music composer, singer and performer** who was active in the film industry from the **1940s to the 1960s.**
 
• He composed music for over **250 films** in various Indian languages, including **Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali and Tamil.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arijit Singh** is a popular **Indian playback singer** who has sung for **numerous Bollywood films.**
 
• **R.D. Burman** was a famous **Indian music composer** who worked in the** Hindi film industry** from the **1960s to the 1990s.**
 
 
• He composed music for over **300 films** and is known for his innovative and experimental approach to music.
 
 
 
• **A.R. Rahman** is another famous** Indian music composer** who has won numerous international awards for his work in Indian films.
 
 
• He is known for his **fusion of Indian classical music** with electronic and world music.
